record.item: A pass mark, written down before the run
record.why: Set afterwards, it bends toward the result you want.

record.item: Every trial, including the ones that went badly
One timestamped signal of task progress
record.why: Without a time series you can only count, not diagnose.
Needed to tell a mid-task failure from running out of time.

record.item: Whether a person intervened, and when
record.why: An unrecorded intervention turns a failure into a success.
So the numbers can be recomputed and disputed later.
